This incident highlights the critical importance of basic fact-checking and the speed with which modern political media will bypass reality to maintain a preferred narrative.

The error lies on the Physical plane (WHERE). Schmitt mistook a college game in Maryland for an NBA game in Atlanta, then committed a Metaphysical error by claiming this physical impossibility proved a conspiracy.

The Unavoidable Truth: A United States Senator comically confused a college women's basketball team with an NBA franchise to allege a federal conspiracy.
The Unavoidable Lie: Jack Smith was caught perjuring himself about being in Atlanta.

MAGA media is covering Eric Schmitt's gaffe during a hearing with Jack Smith as a win, claiming he caught the former special counsel in a lie.

Actual Article Body:
By 

	Jack Crosbie

MAGA firebrand Eric Schmitt came after Jack Smith during a dramatic Senate hearing today, attempting to catch the former special counsel in a lie about his conduct during his high-profile investigations of Donald Trump. Schmitt, however, had his facts completely wrong — not that you’d know it by watching the right-wing content mill.

Instead of admitting the mistake, some MAGA tastemakers have doubled down on Schmitt’s completely wrong assertion that Smith was lying about attending an Atlanta Hawks game in early 2024.

Schmitt’s original gaffe has to be seen to be believed. The Missouri senator thought that he had text messages that proved that Smith was in Atlanta on Feb. 3, 2024, which he believed would have indicated that Smith was somehow colluding with Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis, who was also investigating Trump. Schmitt’s “proof” was a series of text messages from Smith’s staff that referenced a basketball game, which Schmitt was certain was the Hawks’ game against the Golden State Warriors. The texts referenced a game, yes, but one that Smith soon realized likely referred to the University of Maryland women’s NCAA game against the University of Iowa that he attended the same day. Sen. Amy Klobuchar delightedly pointed out that Schmitt had probably mistaken the Hawkeyes (Iowa’s mascot) for the Atlanta Hawks.
